mechanism: Esomeprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing dronedarone metabolism and increasing its plasma concentration, while elevated gastric pH may reduce dronedarone absorption.
action: Monitor for dronedarone toxicity (QT prolongation, bradycardia, hypotension); consider alternative PPI or H2 blocker; measure QTc interval and serum electrolytes periodically.
